title: Machine learning model (ELSA) for the identification and prediction of psychological stress: A validation study.
summary: With this project we aim to better understand the mental health status and issues among university students. In doing so, we have developed the ELSA questionnaire: a novel machine-learning model that uses only non-psychiatric data to predict the risk of detecting a common mental disorder. In addition, the model also provides an individualized and quantifiable identification of risk factors covering various aspects of mental health, such as sociodemographic data, physical health, lifestyle, experiences of discrimination, physical activity, and work/study-related stress.

interventions.name: The research project described here is designed as a multicenter study.
